The rank block identity uses an invertible 2r corner with zero vertex-vertex inverse block and holds in characteristic two. In a windmill k active triangles have cross-pairing rank 0 or 2k+1, and restriction to an n-r dimensional kernel gives all remaining ranks. The closed product for nonsingular symmetric matrices over every finite field is standard and was independently cross-checked against orthogonal/symplectic order formulas. Full enumeration yields the stated polynomial, strict top-rank gap and multiplicities; finite checks are corroboration.

value.rationale: The theorem refines the prior yes/no criterion for existence of nondegenerate invariant metrics by quantifying the full radical-rank spectrum in the canonical infinite windmill family of connected nonquadratic graphical Lie algebras. The missing corank, its first two attainable strata and their exact multiplicities have structural meaning for degenerations of invariant bilinear forms. The arbitrary-graph triangle coordinate and forced radical give an additional graph-combinatorial classification. No unproved downstream application is needed to motivate this natural complete invariant.
